breaking.change: A toast draws nothing itself. The engine used to stack its own toast plates at UiDesc.toastAnchor; the toasts up are now the UI's $toasts store, shown by the built-in notifications screen. UiDesc.toastAnchor is removed, and so is the style pack's toast::part(indicator).
breaking.fix: Load and push the notifications screen once: og.load.document(world, "@ui/screens/notifications.svelte"), then og.ui.push(world, "notifications", { items: [] }). To place or dress toasts, style [part="notifications.frame"] in the style pack or iterate $toasts in a document of your own. og.ui.toast and og.ui.dismissToast keep their signatures.

added.summary: $toasts, read by every document like $ui: the toasts up, oldest first, each { id, text, tone, leaving }. In a row of it, onclick={dismissToast} dismisses that toast; the engine answers it and the game never sees the event.
The built-in notifications screen shows $toasts after its own items: each arrives and leaves with the motion tokens, takes its tone's stripe, and a press dismisses it.
